candidate_relations.reason: The clinical record describes characteristic histological findings of malakoplakia, including dense mixed inflammatory infiltrate with pale histiocytes containing basophilic spherical and targetoid inclusions (Michaelis-Gutmann bodies) that are strongly positive on von Kossa and periodic acid–Schiff stains, in the context of rectal and sigmoid polyps. This is a complete match for the reference diagnosis of Malakoplakia, with the added anatomical specificity of the gastrointestinal tract, which is supported by the colonoscopy findings.
